q2_gaps: an emphatic singular numeral ('on ONE filling') has no carrier — Cardinality rides only on a group witness, so the numeral is dropped and the parse is indistinguishable from 'on a filling'
the completeness modifier inside a duration NP ('a FULL night') has no slot beside the magnitude and unit of (Measure e duration 1 night)
notes: Name handling is textbook — one opaque multi-word symbol, exactly one Name fact, kind stated by a separate type atom, no modifier genus — and the bare simple present correctly gets no status atom (dispositional reading). Patient for the burning lantern follows the non-volitional-process branch of the intransitive-subject test, and (On event filling) is the surface preposition actually used rather than a near-fit Instrument.
